intuition.title: A common gel method with unresolved per-size schedules
intuition.text: The authors use a PEG-gel precursor and air calcination to obtain a series of lithium-ferrite crystal sizes. The main describes only an overall temperature/time window, so the seven measured size outcomes do not establish seven fully specified synthesis settings. Solvent identity, proportions and detailed thermal history remain open fields.

intuition.title: Thermal analysis is evidence about the precursor
intuition.text: The source assigns thermal events to nitrate/PEG decomposition and ferrite formation. This DTA experiment is heated in oxygen at 10 °C/min; its atmosphere and ramp must not be copied into the separately reported air-calcination recipe. The plotted formation event at 303 °C is an analytical assignment, not a universal synthesis setpoint.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1, DTA method and Figure 1

intuition.title: Size-dependent magnetism and a source-proposed surface explanation
intuition.text: The authors observe lower saturation magnetization for smaller crystals and suggest a surface effect, citing reference 5. That proposed explanation is retained as interpretation; this paper does not directly resolve surface chemistry or spin configurations. Its normalized magnetization curves and coercivity trends are kept as plots, without invented numerical sample values.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Magnetic discussion, Figures 3–4 and reference 5

intuition.title: Curie temperature has a different reported size dependence
intuition.text: Table I reports 580 °C for the 9.1 nm sample and 620 °C for the 16.4, 22.6, 32.4 and 46.7 nm samples. The bulk 620 °C row is attributed to reference 6. The table does not report values for the 27.3 nm or greater-than-100 nm outcomes, and those values are not filled by interpolation.

intuition.title: Limits of structural and magnetic labels
intuition.text: The paper reports spinel-type LiFe5O8 and agreement between XRD- and TEM-based average crystal sizes. It supplies no TEM image, shape distribution or atom coordinates. Unresolved trace/symbol assignments and the anomalous printed conversion in Figure 4 remain visible, rather than being silently corrected.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, XRD/TEM methods, Figures 2–4 and captions

scopeLabel: Complete two-page main. One common preparation range with seven named size outcomes; exact per-outcome schedules are unresolved. Any SI and cited full sources unreviewed. Independent scientific audit passed; presentation refinements pending.

sourceAudit.scope: Independent scientific review of both supplied main pages, four figures, Table I and the six-reference bibliography passed without findings. One method supports seven partial size-labelled outcomes; exact per-size schedules and batches remain unresolved. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
